about: Everything that slowed, surprised or annoyed an agent or a person while working on blaze, however slightly, written down when it happens (rule record-annoyances). A row is a lead for guard-the-cause: the fix is to remove the cause, then set the row's state. Rows are never deleted; a fixed one keeps its state and the commit.

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: `sed -i` behaves differently on macOS (BSD needs `-i ''`, cannot put a newline in a replacement) and GNU tools from nix sit first on PATH for some commands (`df -g` failed), so every in-place edit became a Python heredoc.
annoyances.cause: two toolchains on one PATH
annoyances.workaround: edit files with the Edit tool or `python3 -I`; never `sed -i`

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: A file replaced by rename (what `sed -i` and editors do) is sometimes read by the daemon as empty: the build fails with E0601 `main` not found and stays failed until the file is written again.
annoyances.cost: several wrong measurements and two lanes tripped by it
annoyances.cause: the daemon reads the path between the unlink and the create, or acts on the delete event alone
annoyances.workaround: overwrite bytes in place when scripting edits

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: After a daemon restart the first request that sees a changed file never returns; the log holds about 40,000 caught panics (`module … of an item is not in its crate's def map`).
annoyances.cost: hours: I blamed two lanes' changes for it, because every bisect restarted the daemon to swap binaries
annoyances.cause: restored state refers to modules the current front end lacks; each verification panics and is retried
annoyances.workaround: none; do not restart between an edit and a measurement

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: I timed twelve `blaze run` calls without checking exit status or output and reported 18 to 21 ms as a result; it could not be reproduced.
annoyances.cost: a wrong claim to Andrew, retracted 25 minutes later
annoyances.cause: timing harness that discards stdout and the return code
annoyances.workaround: every timing script asserts the expected output and counts failures
annoyances.state: fixed in the harness (/tmp/blaze-h2h2.py); rule claims-from-evidence already said so

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` and `LLVM_SYS_231_PREFIX`, exported in my shell for cargo, were inherited by some blaze commands and not others; blaze then used cargo's target directory and rebuilt the world between requests.
annoyances.cause: blaze honours `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`; a change in it re-keys 22 dependency images; my shell state leaked
annoyances.workaround: run every measured command under `env -i` with a fixed list
annoyances.state: open: moving the target directory should recompute nothing in the front end

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: A rebuilt blaze cannot stop the previous build's daemon (`speaks API schema 49, this blaze 50`), so every rebuild needs `pgrep` and `kill` by pid.
annoyances.cost: a minute per rebuild, dozens of rebuilds
annoyances.cause: `stop` goes through the versioned API
annoyances.workaround: kill by pid
annoyances.state: open: `stop` should work across schema versions

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: `blaze debug sql` needs `BLAZE_DUCKDB` set by hand on the Mac (found one in /nix/store by listing it), and later failed with `the flush asked for was not written in 30s`.
annoyances.cause: blaze never looks for DuckDB on PATH; the history thread was stuck
annoyances.workaround: export the nix-store path
annoyances.state: the flush failure is in a lane's task (run-cost-1111)

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: An 80-minute build's profile kept only its last five minutes of task spans, so the question it was needed for could not be answered from it.
annoyances.cost: an answer I had to get from another run
annoyances.cause: files were retired by the newest build named in them
annoyances.workaround: query sooner; use another run
annoyances.state: fix written on all-1111 (763371a943), not yet exercised on a long build

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: A dev-built blaze looks for the standard library's source in the checkout it was built in; on any other machine it fails after 15 s trying to download from a release URL that does not exist.
annoyances.cause: the library is found by the build's own path
annoyances.workaround: `BLAZE_LIBRARY_FROM=<checkout>/library`

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: bstd uses blaze-only syntax, so no crate on it can be checked or tested with cargo; two new crates were unverifiable until one was ported to core and alloc.

annoyances.workaround: decision D25

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: `cargo test -p a -p b` stops at the first package that fails unless `--no-fail-fast` is given, and several Hegel tests draw a random seed, so one baseline run passed a test that failed one run in three.
annoyances.cause: defaults
annoyances.workaround: always `--no-fail-fast`; run a suspect test five times
annoyances.state: open: failing tests on main are still unclassified

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: The `docs` and `invariants` scripts need a blaze that builds them, and main's Cargo.lock was out of date on macOS, so generated files (docs/README.md's index, invariants.md) were edited by hand by me and by four lanes.
annoyances.cost: small each time; a standing risk that the gate's check fails later
annoyances.cause: generated docs need a working self-build

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code

annoyances.workaround: pipe through `grep` for the names wanted

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: A foreground tool call ends at 600 s and `sleep` is refused, so every long step is a background task plus a notification, and a build-then-measure sequence is spread over several turns.
annoyances.cause: limits of the harness
annoyances.workaround: `run_in_background`, systemd units on VMs

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: `pgrep -fl` matched another agent's process whose command line carries a 10 KB JSON argument, which was printed whole into my context.
annoyances.cause: I used `-l` with `-f`
annoyances.workaround: `ps -o pid,etime,command | cut -c1-110`

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: Tools I needed were deferred or off: SendMessage, TaskStop and WebFetch had to be looked up before use, and the Artifact tool was listed but switched off when Andrew asked for a page to be opened.
annoyances.cause: session configuration
annoyances.workaround: ToolSearch; a local HTML file opened with `open`

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: Reminders that the user has not heard from me arrive in the middle of multi-step tool sequences, so status lines are written before there is a result.
annoyances.cause: long sequences of tool calls
annoyances.workaround: one sentence, then continue

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: I piped output through `cut -c1-34` and then misread `…: 26` as a wrong program result; it was `269` cut off.
annoyances.cause: over-eager truncation
annoyances.workaround: truncate from the left for values at the end of a line

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: `git stash` is banned and worktrees share one object store, so bisecting a merge meant detached-HEAD reverts in the shared worktree and remembering to check the branch out again.

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: With `BLAZE_HOME=/tmp/…` on macOS (`/tmp` is a symlink to `/private/tmp`) the daemon's no-op lane is disabled by design and says nothing, so every `build` and `run` I measured all afternoon was a full walk.
annoyances.cost: every blaze number I reported before 18:40 PST was 2 to 10 times too slow on the no-op rows
annoyances.cause: a path through a symlink is not vouched for; nothing reports that the lane is off
annoyances.workaround: use `/private/tmp/…`
annoyances.state: open: say so once per daemon, or resolve the path

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: Every `blaze run` cloned the 158 MB executable and then rewrote it (the build's placement and the dev host's table each took the other's file for a changed one), about 160 ms per run, and the write made the next build walk.
annoyances.cost: the whole no-op run gap against Relax
annoyances.cause: two owners of one output file
annoyances.workaround: none

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: `ix rm` of old failed VMs is refused (`automation deletes are paused in this region by migration`, `protected streams disk`) after deleting those still on a node; the message does not say that the switch has never been turned on or that an operator must do it.
annoyances.cost: a half-finished cleanup and a round trip to the ix session to learn why
annoyances.cause: the region's reaper switch is still in its initial `Paused` state
annoyances.workaround: none for an agent

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent in Claude Code
annoyances.what: A lane told to stay off VMs created one (`run-cost-1111`) to run Linux-only tests, and removed it afterwards; I learned of it from `ix ls`.
annoyances.cause: the brief said no VMs but the tests it had to write only run on Linux
annoyances.workaround: say in the brief where Linux-only tests may run

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), lane film-1111
annoyances.what: The brief said build the harness crates with cargo, but cargo cannot read the harness workspace at all since 2026-11-10: harness-native-render depends on harness-native-shaders with `artifact = "gpu"`, a blaze extension cargo refuses (`artifact = ... requires -Z bindeps`), and the pinned blaze (0.20261105.4, dated five days before that dependency landed) was not tried: a blaze build of the harness on the Mac beside three other lanes was not a risk to take for a film. The warm target's harness-video was a cargo build from before that merge.
annoyances.cost: about 20 minutes finding a way to build at all
annoyances.cause: the rule change of 2026-11-11 (cargo is the dev-loop builder) and the gpu artifact dependency of 2026-11-10 contradict each other for crates/harness, and neither the README nor the brief says which wins
annoyances.workaround: an uncommitted shim in the lane's worktree: the dependency rewritten as a plain path dependency, BLAZE_GPU_MSL_HARNESS_NATIVE_SHADERS pointed at the mascot.metal an older slangc build left in the target, and cargo +nightly-2026-10-27 (the gpu crate pulls blaze crates that need rustc 1.101, so the default stable 1.99.1 also fails). The film draws no Kip, so the stale MSL only has to compile

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), lane film-1111
annoyances.what: Building from a worktree into main's warm target (so no second multi-GB target) overwrites main's own target/release/harness-video with the lane's build, and cargo wrote crates/harness/Cargo.lock in the worktree (13 packages added for the gpu crate, which the checked-in lock has never listed because only blaze reads it).
annoyances.cost: none yet; main's harness-video binary is now this lane's

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), lane film-1111

annoyances.cost: the H.264 and AAC work had two possible homes; it went where the film's frames actually go (harness-video), and bstd's encoder still has no H.264 provider, no audio provider and no `avc1`/`mp4a` in its muxer
annoyances.cause: two encoders for one concept (rule one-concept-one-home): bstd's cannot take GPU-written frames yet, so harness-video cannot move onto it
annoyances.workaround: none; said in the lane's report

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), lane film-1111

annoyances.cause: api crates are declared flecs-free but hold a type whose Drop needs flecs

annoyances.who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), lane film-1111
